_doc: Họa Tinh Đường's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:hoa_tinh by the serial step. Unpriced. Declares every counter it reads or writes in its own counters array for standalone GDScript compilation.

Rainfast Ink.rule: Rainfast Ink (Vũ Bất Thoát, rainfast-ink-art L1 passive art, d35): your talisman marks (Painted Star), and the debuff stacks and curses your talismans lay, cannot be cleansed; a cleanse that would remove them removes nothing of yours.

Autumn Light on the Screen.rule: The Silver Candle (ht-silver-candle): while the candle is lit, the first damaging talisman you throw at the foe each fight is painted twice: it strikes again 1 s later at half strength. Out-of-fight crafting bonus (talismans painted by its light keep a grade higher) is unmodelled in combat.
Autumn Light on the Screen.approx: fire_art {which: "longest", share: 0.5} on the pulse 1 s after the first talisman hit replays the main damaging talisman at half strength; the out-of-fight talisman-painting grade bonus is crafting lore.

Seven Stars in One Stroke.rule: Candle and Ink, full set (2 pieces: ht-silver-candle, ht-rainfast-ink-gourd): every seventh talisman you throw at one foe closes the Dipper: it deals 0.85 Chaos damage per Wood debuff stack on that foe and spends them all, and your talisman marks and curses on that foe cannot be cleansed for 8 s.
